Package org.drip.state.eostree

EOS Bond Tree Based Valuation
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    BondEvaluator
    BondEvaluator exports the Bond Evaluator Functionality to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    BondPriceFunction
    BondPriceFunction calibrates the specified Base Bond Yield used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    FullBondEvaluator
    FullBondEvaluator implements the DRIP Bond Evaluator to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    FullBondValueGrid
    FullBondValueGrid holds the Valuation Grid for Full EOS Bonds generated by the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ProxyBondEvaluator
    ProxyBondEvaluator implements the Bond Proxy Evaluator to be used in the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ProxyBondValueGrid
    ProxyBondValueGrid holds the Valuation Grid for EOS Proxy Bonds generated by the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    SliceElastic
    SliceElastic holds the Path-dependent Properties of a Single Cross-vertex Slice built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    ValueGrid
    ValueGrid holds the Valuation Grid for EOS Bonds generated by the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    VertexAccrual
    VertexAccrual holds the Path-independent Vertex Accrual Properties of a Single Vertex with Pillar Segments built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    VertexElastic
    VertexElastic holds the Path-dependent Vertex Properties of a Single Slice Vertex with Pillar Segments built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    VertexEventComposite
    VertexEventComposite holds the Composite of the Single Coupon/Accrual/MaturityExercise/Principal Vertex Events built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
    VertexInelastic
    VertexInelastic holds the Path-dependent Vertex Properties of a Single Vertex with Pillar Segments built according to the Kalotay, Williams, and Fabozzi (1993) Tree-based Model for valuing bonds with Embedded Options.
